name.en: Aluminium rail and quick clamps on insulated sandwich-panel roofs (Indexfix PSA type)
name.es: Perfil de aluminio y garras rápidas sobre cubiertas de panel sándwich aislado (tipo Indexfix PSA)

description.en: Aluminium winged profiles (PSA-A) are fixed across the rib high points of an insulated sandwich panel with self-drilling stainless steel screws and sealing elements (EPDM, butyl tape, watertight rivet). Joints are rigid (two screws per side) or expansion joints. Quick pre-assembled clamps with a gauge for the module frame height carry the modules. Reference family: Indexfix FTA PSA system.
description.es: Perfiles de aluminio con aletas (PSA-A) se fijan sobre los puntos altos de las nervaduras del panel sándwich aislado con tornillos autoperforantes de acero inoxidable y elementos de sellado (EPDM, cinta de butilo, remache estanco). Las uniones pueden ser rígidas (dos tornillos por lado) o de dilatación. Garras rápidas preensambladas con galga de altura de marco sujetan los módulos. Familia de referencia: sistema PSA de Indexfix (FTA).

typical_use: Insulated sandwich-panel roofs (metal faces with insulation core), non-penetrating apart from the screw and rivet fixings to the panel ribs.
applicable_standards: EN 1999-1-1 (aluminium design, designer; not verified in this research)
Sandwich-panel manufacturer fixing approval (to be obtained per panel; not found)

materials.component: Winged aluminium profile (PSA-A) and aluminium PSA joint (PSA-UN)
Thin-sheet screws TAC-N / TAC-B and ARENI / AUENI
materials.material: Atlantis or bimetal thin-sheet (per source naming; size and grade not stated)
Aluminium, stainless steel, EPDM (system materials per source)

materials.component: Sealing: EPDM and butyl tape under PSA-A
materials.material: EPDM; butyl tape on rib high points

geometry.description: Winged profile runs across the panel ribs, fixed at rib high points. Expansion joint every 12 m (max 300 mm to nearest fixing). Schematic only: fixing pitch along the profile not stated.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

reference_layout.note: Joint screws at 50 to 70 mm from profile end (per source). Expansion joint gap 4 to 6 mm with no screws. Module frame height 30 to 40 mm for the gauge GM-A.

quantity.note: Count per module not stated. Torque 14 Nm for intermediate and lateral clamp screws.

accessories.purpose: Holds module frame on the winged profile. The KFRSC3050 variant is used at row ends.

accessories.name: Sample clamp (module clamp variant, per Indexfix manual)

quantity.note: Count not stated. Torque 14 Nm for lateral clamp screw per manual.

accessories.purpose: Module clamp referenced in installation steps; function (mid or end) not stated.

accessories.name: Gauge for solar frame (GM-A)

quantity.note: Tool: one gauge set per installation. Gauge must equal module frame height.

accessories.purpose: Setting tool that sets clamp height to the module frame height (30 to 40 mm).

accessories.name: Aluminium PSA joint (PSA-UN) and lower connection (mounting connector TU-RXA2)

quantity.note: Count per joint not stated. Rigid joint 2 screws per side; expansion joint has no screws.

accessories.purpose: Joins two winged profiles, rigid or expansion type.

quantity.note: Count not stated; sizes not stated.

grounding_bonding: Grounding and bonding were not stated in the Indexfix PSA installation manual reviewed. Bonding must be obtained from the manufacturer or designed per the local standard.
installation_notes: Thermal expansion: joint every 12 m; expansion joint gap 4 to 6 mm with no screws, maximum 300 mm to the nearest fixing point.
Rigid joint: 2 screws per side; joint screw position 50 to 70 mm from profile end.
Gauge GM-A must equal module frame height (30 to 40 mm).
Clamp screws 14 Nm (intermediate and lateral clamp) per manual.
Predrill diameters not stated in the manual; sandwich panel thickness not stated.
